en:
You'd think an eyesore like the End Wall
would be all over the news or something...

But I had never even heard of it.
You hadn't either, right?

And all these books in different languages...
Maybe we're in some foreign country...

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time speculating about this
place with Maki...
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
